headlines.title: Francesca Hong avoids attacks as Wisconsin Democrats meet for governor debate
headlines.description: The five Democratic candidates for governor in Wisconsin almost entirely refrained from lobbing attacks at one another during their only debate Tuesday night, even as the volatile race enters its final two weeks.

headlines.title: Iran Launches Surprise Missile Attack on US Forces in Middle East
headlines.description: After a dayslong pause in direct strikes between the United States and Iran, the war is flaring up again after U.S. Central Command said it intercepted multiple ballistic missiles launched in a surprise attack by Iran on US forces late Tuesday. It comes just hours after President Donald Trump touted progress in peace talks and as the conflict enters its sixth month. NBC’s Gabe Gutierrez reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Dr. Anthony Fauci's journal reveals how Trump and Biden handled Covid cases
headlines.description: Dr. Anthony Fauci's journal entries, published this week by a Republican senator, offer new details about how the administrations of Presidents Donald Trump and Joe Biden handled their Covid cases. NBC News’ Monica Alba explains the journal revelations as Fauci is set to testify before a Senate committee.

headlines.title: European wildfires force new evacuations
headlines.description: Thousands more are evacuated from historic wildfires in France, Spain, and Italy. Firefighters are in an all-out battle to stop them, and the weather is not helping. NBC News’ Raf Sanchez is near the front lines in France.

headlines.title: Fed interest rate vote poses a test for Warsh as Iran war, tariff push send prices higher
headlines.description: Inflation and affordability are top issues for the Federal Reserve’s rate-setting committee as it votes on whether to raise interest rates or keep them steady.

headlines.title: Powerful earthquake in Japan causes widespread damage
headlines.description: A 6.8 earthquake struck the southern Japanese island of Kyushu leaving dozens injured and causing extensive damage. First responders are now racing to save lives as authorities warn the public to remain vigilant. NBC News’ Matt Bradley has more.

headlines.title: Torrential rain pummels the Northeast
headlines.description: Tens of millions in the Northeast are facing torrential downpours from powerful, slow-moving storms. This as the upper Midwest cleans up from multiple tornadoes there. NBC News’ Maggie Vespa reports from Wisconsin.

headlines.title: Fauci testifies before the Senate on the Covid pandemic
headlines.description: Watch live coverage as Dr. Anthony Fauci testifies before the Senate Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee as part of Committee Chairman Rand Paul's investigation into the origins of Covid. Lawmakers are expected to question Fauci about what he knew and didn't know as the pandemic was unfolding.

headlines.title: Fed interest rate vote poses a test for Warsh as Iran war, tariff push send prices higher
headlines.description: Inflation and affordability are top issues for the Federal Reserve’s rate-setting committee as it votes on whether to raise interest rates or keep them steady.

headlines.title: At least 13 killed in Japan earthquake as rescuers search for survivors in a ‘race against time’
headlines.description: At least 13 people have been killed in southwestern Japan after a magnitude-7.1 earthquake, Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi said Wednesday, as rescuers searched for people trapped in collapsed buildings including a shopping mall.

headlines.title: Iran launches attacks on U.S. targets, shattering dayslong lull in fighting
headlines.description: The fighting shattered a brief period of calm after weeks of escalation between the U.S. and Iran over the strategic Strait of Hormuz.

headlines.title: James Comey legal team argues DOJ’s seashells case erodes ‘bedrock’ principles
headlines.description: It’s the second time the Trump administration has found a way to criminally charge the former FBI director, whom Trump has targeted for years.
